concept: ExplainMode is the SK 4 manual printed on the real screen. One key turns on a how this works mode that prints each part's name and one line of what it does in the free space under it, joined by a thin leader, while every control keeps working and the same key or Escape takes the printing away.

default_to_avoid.pattern: product tour or explain mode in the Intro.js or Shepherd manner, a spotlight hole in a dark scrim with a popover and Next buttons
default_to_avoid.why_not: A scrim blocks every control and shows one part at a time, and the white popover is a second material; P5 asks for printing flat on the case and P6 for nothing that takes over the screen.

default_to_avoid.pattern: coach marks as floating tooltip bubbles with arrows that pulse to get attention
default_to_avoid.why_not: Bubbles float above the surface with their own shadow and pulse while idle, which P5 and P6 forbid, since printing is flat and nothing moves without a change of state.

references.source: The user's wave 4 reference: the Braun SK 4 manual naming parts on the photographed object, Lautstärke and Sender printed under the knobs
WAI-ARIA aria-describedby: a description is read after the name when a control takes focus
WCAG 2.2 success criterion 1.4.13 Content on Hover or Focus: added content can be dismissed with Escape and does not hide what it explains

derivation.consequence: labels sit on the body's inset line, never floating mid-surface
derivation.form: Each name prints in the free space under its part, centred on it, and moves to above, the end or the start only when under is taken; it never sits over another part.

derivation.consequence: one grotesk, regular and medium only; hierarchy by size and position
derivation.form: The name is set at label size in the medium weight and the line of what it does at caption size in the regular weight below it.
The printing appears and leaves at once when the mode changes, with no fade, no slide and no pulse.

derivation.consequence: a relation is a hairline of ink with a small node where it meets a part
derivation.form: A thin straight leader of secondary ink runs from the part's edge to its name, the same hairline the relation lines use.

derivation.consequence: the display is a live region (polite) and never a control
derivation.form: Turning the mode on is said once in a polite status line, and the printed lines say what a part does, never its value, which the display already tells.

options.name: printed under the part, the SK 4 manual's name and one line under each knob with a short vertical leader
margin callouts, the book home's leaders with names standing in two side lanes outside the unit
numbered legend, printed numerals beside each part and a key of names at the foot of the unit
spotlight tour, a scrim with one hole and a popover with Next, rendered to reject

variants.reason: A puts the name where the hand already is and needs no margin beside the unit, so it fits a phone (P5 space); B needs empty lanes a phone screen does not have, C makes the eye read a numeral then look down and back, and D blocks the controls.

root.why: The root keeps the layout the screen gives its parts, so turning the mode on moves nothing.

layer.why: The printing sits in one flat layer that never takes a pointer, so every control under it keeps working.

leads.why: All leaders sit in one flat drawing inside the printing layer, with no shadow and no emboss.

lead.why: A leader is one straight hairline of ink from the part's edge to the start of its name.

note.why: A note is placed in free space next to its part, never over another part or another note.

name.why: The part's name is set at label size in the medium weight, as printing names a knob.

does.why: The line of what the part does is secondary ink on plastic and still holds the contrast for text.

bar.why: The how this works key is a plastic key, never orange, so the unit's one loud control stays the loud one.

part.why: A part wraps one control and hands it the printed name and line as its description while the mode is on.

status.why: A visually hidden polite status says once that the mode is on and that Escape closes it.

mark.why: Where no free space is left beside a part, a small printed numeral in tabular figures stands beside it instead.

key.why: The key under the unit lists the numbered notes, after the toggle key so the key you pressed stays put.

keyItem.why: Each key entry sets the numeral, the name in medium and the line in regular on one baseline.

keyNumber.why: The numeral in the key is secondary ink on plastic, the same as the numeral printed beside the part.

keyWrap.why: The key opens its height on the change of state, so the content under the unit moves over a short time instead of jumping.

data-side=end.why: A note printed after its part starts its lines at the edge nearest the part, so the leader meets the first word.

data-side=start.why: A note printed before its part ends its lines at the edge nearest the part, so the leader meets the last word.

@media forced-colors: active.why: In forced colours the leaders and both lines of text take the system text colour so the printing survives.

@media prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.why: Under reduced motion the key opens and closes at once, with no change of height over time.

block-size.why: Only the key's height moves, over motion.enter, when the mode turns on or off; the printing itself never animates.
